recap.text: The Maestro puts Li Jun and Zhang against Brindled Vespas for a show. Carl, the man with the cat, gambles that he is too valuable to the production to be punished and gets Li Jun, Li Na, and Zhang out. Li Jun owes Carl more than anyone.

Li Jun is ninth on the draft leaderboard as a level twenty-five human Street Monk with a bounty of one hundred thousand. Carl remembers Li Jun from the Maestro's show, where he helped save him from troglodytes and brindle grubs.

Li Jun and a thousand crawlers are stuck at 101 on the Vermillion line. Carl lets Li Jun into an engine room filled with blood and shows him how to drive the train. Li Jun takes twelve people, including his sister and Zhang, back to station 36 to make a stand.

Li Jun slides down a chain shot by his sister and lands in front of Carl, who has a spider's body under him. Carl puts a stick from a tattoo kit into Li Jun's eye and eats it. Carl tells the sister not to heal Li Jun and drops a gold standard healing potion on the floor.

Li Jun builds two splash towers in Shanty Town and watches Lucia Mar drink at the Possum Envy with her dog. He holds doors at Club Vanquisher while Katia, Carl, Prepotente, and Samantha drag a wire. Li Jun uses his Engine of Tomorrow eye to see muscles tense and slow time. He dies after using speaker number eleven to play a song for Princess Donut to stop Harpocrates.

beats.headline: Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem
beats.text: The Maestro puts Zhang and me up against Brindled Vespas and does all the talking for us. That is the show. We are the part that gets hurt. Then Carl, the one with the cat, works out that he is worth too much to the production to be punished, and gambles on it, in front of everyone, and it holds. He gets us out. Zhang, our boss, me, and my sister Li Na. I owe a man I have just met more than I have ever owed anyone.
beats.gist: The Maestro puts Li Jun and Zhang against Brindled Vespas while Carl gambles to save them.

beats.headline: Ninth on the board
beats.text: Ninth on the draft leaderboard: Li Jun, human, Street Monk, level twenty-five, bounty one hundred thousand. Carl remembers him from the Maestro's show, the one he helped save from the troglodytes and brindle grubs, and is glad to see him there. He hopes Zhang and the others are doing well too.
beats.gist: Li Jun is a level twenty-five human Street Monk with a one hundred thousand bounty.

beats.headline: A thousand stranded at 101
beats.text: We are stuck at 101 on the Vermillion line, my team and something like a thousand other crawlers, and we are not getting out on our own. Word comes through that Hekla's people have reached Carl's safe room and asked for his help, that a train is ready at stop 60, and that Katia means to use her own body to get it through. I do not know what that means. I have decided to find it encouraging.
beats.gist: Li Jun and a thousand crawlers are stuck at 101 on the Vermillion line.

beats.headline: Saved again, and a train to drive
beats.text: I knock on the engine door and Carl lets me in, to more blood than I have ever seen in one room. My sister and Zhang are safe in the cargo near the front; we are twelve now. We have been saved, again, by him, and I have come to pay my respects. He shows me how to drive the train. I will take everyone back to station 36, where his friends are already waiting, and we will make a stand. I ask why not 24, which has stairs and no ghouls. Nobody knows yet what will go there.
beats.gist: Li Jun knocks on the engine door and Carl lets him in.

beats.headline: Down the chain to Carl
beats.text: My sister shoots a chain down through the burning floor, and I slide down it and land in front of Carl. He has a spider's body under him and he is not talking like Carl. I ask him what I can do. He takes a stick out of a tattoo kit and puts it into my eye. Then he eats my eye. I am on the floor in the corner with my hand over my face, and my sister is between us. He tells her not to heal me. Then he drops a gold standard healing potion on the floor, and says it is for me.
beats.gist: Li Jun slides down a chain and lands before Carl, who has a spider's body.

beats.headline: Two towers, and Lucia Mar
beats.text: Shanty Town's defences are still going up. We have two towers built, both splash towers, and that is all. We are working as fast as we can, and my sister says two more in twenty minutes. And Florin, you wanted to know about Lucia Mar. She is here in Shanty Town right now with her dog, drinking at the Possum Envy, right on the edge of the border. One of the new guys tried to recruit her. She almost ripped his head off.
beats.gist: Li Jun tells Florin that Shanty Town has two splash towers and Lucia Mar is drinking.

beats.headline: Holding the doors at Club Vanquisher
beats.text: Katia, Carl, Prepotente and Samantha are going into Club Vanquisher, and they are dragging a wire behind them long enough to extend my sister's auras all the way inside. Somebody has to keep the path open behind them. That is Bautista, Zhang and me. Doors. We are holding doors. It is not glamorous, and it is exactly the job I would have asked for, and I am holding mine.
beats.gist: Li Jun, Bautista, and Zhang hold doors for Katia, Carl, Prepotente, and Samantha at Club Vanquisher.

beats.headline: The Engine of Tomorrow
beats.text: My new eye is the Engine of Tomorrow. Swirling black until it works, then a tiny clockwork engine. It lets me see muscles tense and slows time for me in short bursts, so I can see where a strike is going. My sister and I train with it nonstop. On the way to the brig I ask Carl how he's doing. He lists his worries: Louis, Donut, Elle's plan, Boomer's battalion, the war mages. Yes, but what about you? Donut says he got over thirty boxes, and he's shown us a brush and some potions. And his hands are glowing now.
beats.gist: Li Jun gets the Engine of Tomorrow eye to see tensing muscles and slow time.

beats.headline: Speaker number eleven
beats.text: Crawler Li Jun is dead. Harpocrates had marked Princess Donut for death and was closing on her tower before her rolling ball could reach its destination. Li Jun had a plan: speaker number eleven, still on the back of a cart, every other speaker muted, playing the song he had sent her. He told his sister he would jump before the god caught him. His last message to her asked her to protect Zhang, to be kind, and promised to tell their mother she said hello. The next message from him arrived marked as from a deceased crawler.
beats.gist: Li Jun dies to save Princess Donut from Harpocrates using speaker number eleven on a cart.

relations.note: Same warehouse, same shift, same stairs.
